profile.headline: Software Engineer | Java, Spring Boot, AWS

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description:
Improving is a modern digital services company offering innovative technology solutions through custom application development, agile transformation, and consulting. 
 
As a Senior Consultant, I have the opportunity to create, build, maintain, and iterate on technology-driven solutions where collaboration is key. My specialties include Java, Spring, SQL and many other open-source tools and frameworks that allow me to solve unique problems across a wide variety of industry domains and environments. We embrace change, appreciate variety, and thrive solving complex challenges with modern technology.
